source: CPTS Module 03: Network Enumeration with Nmap
notes:
-sS  TCP SYN (stealth, default w/ root)
-sT  TCP connect (no root)
-sA  TCP ACK (firewall mapping)
-sW  TCP Window   -sM  TCP Maimon
-sU  UDP scan
-sN/-sF/-sX  Null / FIN / Xmas
--scanflags <flags>  custom TCP flags
-sI <zombie[:port]>  idle/zombie scan
-sY/-sZ  SCTP INIT / COOKIE-ECHO
-sO  IP protocol scan
-b <FTP relay host>  FTP bounce Also covered in: OSCP PEN-200 Chapter 6 (Information Gathering).
